summary: Verified GST 5% + Convenience 5% pricing change. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_order_pricing.py with 3 new tests (qty=1, qty=2, persisted total_amount). All 28 backend tests pass (28/28, including auth, drops, orders + 3 new pricing). Frontend: admin login -> /home renders 10 drop cards with vendor info. critical_code_review_comments: server.py:430-433 -> gst = round(subtotal*0.05,2); convenience_fee = round(subtotal*0.05,2); total = round(subtotal+gst+conv,2); amount_paise = int(total*100). Correctly implements 10% surcharge.

checkout.tsx:35-37 -> gst = Math.round(subtotal*0.05); convenienceFee = Math.round(subtotal*0.05); total = subtotal+gst+convenienceFee. Matches backend (note: integer Math.round on frontend vs 2-decimal round on backend; works because seed prices are integer multiples).
Razorpay order creation generates fake order_id (server.py:435) — MOCKED, intended for non-prod.

Note: For non-integer discounted_price values (e.g. ₹99.50), frontend Math.round could diverge by ₹1 from backend's round(_,2)*100 paise. Currently all seeded prices are integers so unobservable, but recommend aligning rounding (use toFixed(2)) for future float prices.
